[[File:Area_D-504.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Area D-504, aka Ith'ril Eventide]]
'''Ith'ril Eventide''', previously known as '''Area D-504''', was an area of space in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. Area D-504 was overrun by the [[Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild]] during the the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. It was later renamed Ith'ril Eventide in honor of the [[Ith'ril Eventide|leader]] of the Zel'iphian Slave Traders.<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space_poi|Ith'ril Eventide|Dantooine system}}</ref>
